name: FinToolBench
description: FinToolBench is the first real-world, runnable benchmark dedicated to evaluating financial tool learning agents. It couples 760 executable financial tools with 295 rigorous, tool-required queries and assesses agents on timeliness, intent type, and regulatory domain alignment.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the financial tool-use literature, with early adoption mainly among researchers working on agentic tool learning in finance.
notes: Provides a realistic ecosystem for financial tool use evaluation; introduces a finance-aware tool retrieval and reasoning baseline.
